name: Bucks to the Demon
source:
Diego, an unlucky deer that lost his boyfriend due to internal drama, now seeks for a new one... Where will he find his perfect match? Really? Will he need to literally make a pact with a demon to achieve his carnal desires?

[From [url=https://tavios.itch.io/bucks-to-the-demon]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
迭戈是一只不幸的鹿，由于内心的戏剧性事件失去了男朋友，现在正在寻找新的男朋友……他将在哪里找到他的完美伴侣？真的吗？他是否需要与恶魔签订契约才能实现他的肉欲？

[来自[url=https://tavios.itch.io/bucks-to-the-demon]Itch.io[/url]]
